---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem This Solves

Describe the problem this feature would solve. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## ✨ Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## 📊 Use Cases

Describe specific situations where this would be useful:

1. When...
2. If...
3. To help with...

## 🎨 Mockups/Examples

If you have mockups, examples from other apps, or visual ideas, share them here!

## 💭 Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## ⚡ Priority

How important is this to you?

- [ ] Critical - Blocking my use of the app
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just an idea

## 🙋 Would You Like to Help?

- [ ] I'd like to work on this myself
- [ ] I can help test this feature
- [ ] I can provide more details if needed
- [ ] Just suggesting the idea
